browser_tab.name: 01. BROWSER TAB / HEADER
browser_tab.description:
Hover over your browser tab header (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude tab).
Antigravity clicks here to bring your browser window to the foreground.

prompt_box.name: 02. CHAT COMPOSER / PROMPT BOX
prompt_box.description:
Hover inside the message composer textarea.
Antigravity clicks here to paste images (Ctrl+V) and paste CAD prompts.

send_button.name: 03. SEND / SUBMIT BUTTON
send_button.description:
Hover over the send arrow / submit button.
Antigravity clicks here to dispatch prompts to the LLM.

copy_button.name: 04. COPY RESPONSE BUTTON
copy_button.description:
Hover over the copy response icon at the bottom of the LLM output.
Antigravity clicks here to extract the generated 3D CAD data.

antigravity_header.name: 05. ANTIGRAVITY WINDOW / TOP HEADER
antigravity_header.description:
Hover over the top title bar or tab header of this Antigravity IDE window.
Antigravity clicks here to bring the IDE window to the top/foreground.

ide_chat_box.name: 06. ANTIGRAVITY IDE CHAT INPUT
ide_chat_box.description:
Hover inside the chat input box at the bottom of this Antigravity IDE window.
Antigravity clicks here to paste the browser's LLM response directly into this chat.
